title.en: MaLACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A PORTION OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF NAUJAN, PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL MIN- DORO, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF VICTORIA.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
shall be the seat of government, Old Macatoc, Babas-
nan, New Macatoc-Townsite, Ordovilla, San Narciso, Mali-
yas, Buliran, Pakias, Gusay, Bambang, and Merrit.
The municipality of Naujan shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Victoria.
The municipality of Victoria shall begin to exist upon
the certification by the Secretary of Finance or the
Provincial Treasurer of Oriental Mindoro that said u-
nicipality is financially capable of implementing the pro-
visions of the Minimum Wage Law and upon the appoint-
ment and quaiification of the mayor, vice-mayor and a
majority of the councilors thereof.
*
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of Sep-
tember, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines,
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3767
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
